title: Curated flagship sites (hand-maintained, approximate locations)
publisher: Atlas maintainers, linking to Wikidata where available

properties.name: Shell Energy and Chemicals Park Rotterdam (Pernis)
properties.summary: Shell's largest refinery in Europe, integrated with chemicals production in the Port of Rotterdam.

properties.name: Holland Hydrogen 1
properties.summary: 200 MW renewable-hydrogen electrolyser on Maasvlakte 2, designed to run on offshore wind from Hollandse Kust Noord and supply Pernis.

properties.name: Hollandse Kust Noord (CrossWind)
properties.summary: 759 MW offshore wind farm developed by CrossWind, a Shell–Eneco joint venture.

properties.name: Shell Moerdijk
properties.summary: Petrochemicals complex producing ethylene, propylene and derivatives.

properties.name: Energy Transition Campus Amsterdam
properties.summary: Shell's largest technology centre, focused on low-carbon energy and digital research.

properties.name: Shell Energy and Chemicals Park Rheinland
properties.summary: Germany's largest refinery site (Godorf and Wesseling), also home to the REFHYNE electrolyser.

properties.name: Shell Centre (global headquarters)
properties.summary: Shell plc headquarters on London's South Bank.

properties.name: Nyhamna gas processing plant
properties.summary: Onshore plant that processes Ormen Lange gas for export to the UK via Langeled. Gassco operates it, with Shell as technical service provider.

properties.name: Northern Lights CO₂ terminal
properties.summary: Open-access carbon transport and storage: a joint venture of Equinor, Shell and TotalEnergies.

properties.name: Pearl GTL
properties.summary: The world's largest gas-to-liquids plant, at Ras Laffan, developed by Shell with QatarEnergy.

properties.name: Prelude FLNG
properties.summary: The world's largest floating LNG facility, moored in the Browse Basin about 475 km north-east of Broome.

properties.name: Queensland Curtis LNG
properties.summary: Coal-seam gas to LNG export terminal on Curtis Island, Gladstone, supplied by Shell's QGC business.

properties.name: Gorgon LNG
properties.summary: LNG and domestic gas project on Barrow Island. Chevron operates it, with Shell as a partner.

properties.name: LNG Canada
properties.summary: Canada's first large-scale LNG export terminal at Kitimat, BC. Shell is the largest shareholder.

properties.name: Scotford Refinery & Chemicals
properties.summary: Refinery and chemicals plant near Fort Saskatchewan, Alberta.

properties.name: Shell Polymers Monaca
properties.summary: Ethane cracker and polyethylene complex in Pennsylvania, fed by Appalachian shale gas.

properties.name: Shell Norco Energy & Chemicals Park
properties.summary: Integrated refinery and chemicals site on the Mississippi River, Louisiana.

properties.name: Nigeria LNG (Bonny Island)
properties.summary: Multi-train LNG export plant on Bonny Island. Shell holds a minority stake.

properties.name: Bonga FPSO
properties.summary: Nigeria's first deepwater development, about 120 km offshore in ~1,000 m of water, operated by Shell's SNEPCo.

properties.name: Brunei LNG
properties.summary: One of the world's longest-running LNG plants (since 1972), at Lumut.

properties.name: Oman LNG
properties.summary: LNG plant at Qalhat near Sur. Shell is the largest private shareholder.

properties.name: Karachaganak
properties.summary: Giant gas-condensate field in north-west Kazakhstan, jointly operated by Shell and Eni.

properties.name: Kashagan
properties.summary: Super-giant offshore oil field in the North Caspian Sea, developed by the NCOC consortium.

properties.name: Tupi (Lula)
properties.summary: Pre-salt super-giant in the Santos Basin. Petrobras operates it, with Shell as a major partner.

properties.name: Mero
properties.summary: Pre-salt field in the Libra area of the Santos Basin, produced through multiple FPSOs.

properties.name: Vaca Muerta (Shell Argentina)
properties.summary: Unconventional shale-oil blocks in Neuquén operated by Shell Argentina.

notes: Curated list reviewed as of 2026-11. Ownership changes; verify before relying on it.
